_DRAFT: Boat overlay v2 manifest DRAFT (cc-t3 #91, 2026-10-10). Static-only; no board. Corrects the v1 manifest in scripts/lab/boat_layer_stage.sh, whose liboh_android_runtime.so entry ships the boat libandroid blob adc125f4 aliased to the runtime path. Verdicts below are per-file ABI/class checks vs the U13 base the overlay binds over (u13-stageA-91272eaf-20261003). Cross-references cx-bms benchmark/2026-10-10-boat-runtime-jni-gap/ (commit 1a1eb6e6bd) for the weak-stub + SONAME findings and the forthcoming runtime-delta patch spec.

v1_defect.root_cause: adc125f4 is the BoatAttack libandroid CLASSNAME_FIX (= U13 libandroid 9ccf64f8 + 49 bytes, 268/268 exports). The Boat packaging RENAMED that libandroid.so blob to liboh_android_runtime.so (the boat-assembled dir holds it as libandroid.so, with NO separate runtime file) and the v1 manifest binds it at the runtime path.
v1_defect.measured_regression: abi_diff(old=U13 runtime 18763dd4, new=adc125f4): 787 -> 268 exports, 520 REMOVED, 1 added, 0 drift. The removed set includes the entire android::CursorWindow surface (18763dd4: 24 strong CursorWindow exports; adc125f4: 0). cx-bms 1a1eb6e6bd: adc125f4's four SQLite/CursorWindow registrars are WEAK empty stubs -> nativeOpen DB path non-functional for ALL 128 apps.

SONAME_dedup_steady_state.finding: All three liboh_android_runtime-family files declare the SAME SONAME = liboh_android_runtime.so: U13 libandroid 9ccf64f8, U13 runtime 18763dd4, boat adc125f4 (evidence/soname-and-cursorwindow.txt, llvm-readelf -d).
SONAME_dedup_steady_state.NOT_a_new_risk: The dedup is the existing benign steady state, not something the overlay introduces. U13 base already ships libandroid.so (9ccf64f8) AND liboh_android_runtime.so (18763dd4) side by side with this SONAME and all 128 apps light -> the FULL runtime 18763dd4 (787 exports incl CursorWindow) is the first-loaded winner today.
SONAME_dedup_steady_state.boat_defect: By binding the stripped blob adc125f4 (268 exports, 0 CursorWindow) at the runtime path, Boat makes the DEFICIENT copy the first-loaded SONAME owner; the dedup then serves adc's stripped surface to everything. The mechanism is unchanged; only the winner flipped.
SONAME_dedup_steady_state.path_swap_corollary: Moving adc to the libandroid.so path does not help: CursorWindow is runtime-only (U13 libandroid also has 0) and the SONAME winner is decided by load order, not by which path you wrote. The owner must stay the full runtime object.
confirm_owner_method: 1. readelf -d SONAME (DONE): all three share the SONAME, so dedup applies.
2. scripts/lab/open_site_scan.py on deployed appspawn-x + child: which path is dlopen/dlopen_ns'd first per namespace = the SONAME winner.

3. deployed /proc/<pid>/maps of a live app (Boat + non-Boat, read-only): both paths bound on disk but one in maps = the winner; healthy U13 base = 18763dd4; the check confirms whether Boat flipped it to adc.
4. Verdict rule: the owner must be the full runtime object; any overlay that makes a stripped copy the first-loaded SONAME winner is unsafe regardless of path.

recommended_v2.summary: Do NOT ship adc125f4 at any /system path. Port the Boat render delta INTO the U13 runtime 18763dd4 (single artifact, 787 exports + real CursorWindow/SQLite registrars + render fix, one SONAME, no dedup ambiguity). Keep the verified adapter. Gate the jar on the real-artifact class check.
recommended_v2.runtime_fix_cross_ref: cx-bms to produce the patch spec that ports the Boat 47-byte render delta (cf. §4 49-byte libandroid diff; cx-bms 1a1eb6e6bd measures a 47-byte increment to port) into 18763dd4. This manifest and that spec cross-reference each other. Until that artifact exists + is single-variable re-proven for render, the runtime stays U13 base 18763dd4 (render-correct path UNVERIFIED with 18763dd4).
